model.statement: The short unconditioned synthetic protocol has a small mean plastic-weight effect with seed-dependent sign; model the effect by the measured mean and between-seed variation instead of a uniformly positive lower bound.
model.prediction_rule: For a new three-seed mean, use discovery mean plus or minus three discovery sample SDs as a falsifiable heuristic; this is not a confidence interval.

reason: All paired validity gates passed. Mean 0.00007634276666666773 fell below preregistered 0.0001. Seed 2203 decreased, so the uniformly positive approximation is unsupported. Replace that assumption with a small effect plus seed variation.
next_test: Use untouched seeds 2301,2302,2303, identical 12-window native protocol and STDP-off controls; fix the heuristic interval before observing outcomes.
limitations: A small deterministic synthetic protocol from unconditioned weights. No biological calibration, learning advantage, full Potter reproduction, population confidence interval, or hardware evidence. Prebuilt binary identity is retained; source-to-binary reproducibility is not established here. The revised interval is estimated from three seeds and is a heuristic, not calibrated probabilistic uncertainty.
